title: Aaja Asghar Veer Na Shaama Pai Gaiyan
body:
Pyaasa Teriyan Ghazi Nu kho ke le Gaiyan
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab Di koi peshi na Jaway
Pal pal yaad Abbas di aaway
Behna Rondiyan pit Diyan, Haaye rahe gaiyan
<<DIVIDER>>
Laash ghazidi khaimay nahi
Kon sunay Zainab Di dua hu
Saade sir Diyan chadaran sir toh le gaiyan
<<DIVIDER>>
Veeran Nu phirey lab di Sakina
Aagaya vekh ke Shimr kamina
Tenu aa mila saariyan aa sa kehgaiyan
